role.en: Theologian and bishop of Hippo Regius

summary.en: Born to a Berber family in Roman Numidia, Augustine taught rhetoric in Carthage, Rome and Milan before his conversion. As bishop of Hippo for 35 years he wrote the Confessions and The City of God, shaping Western Christian thought; he died as the Vandals besieged his city.
summary.zh: 奥古斯丁出生于罗马努米底亚的柏柏尔家庭，曾在迦太基、罗马和米兰教授修辞学，后皈依基督教。他任希波主教35年，著有《忏悔录》和《上帝之城》，深刻影响西方基督教思想；在汪达尔人围城期间去世。

label.zh: 生于努米底亚的塔加斯特
在迦太基学习修辞学
在罗马教授修辞学

label.en: Imperial rhetor in Milan; baptised by Ambrose (387)
label.zh: 任米兰宫廷修辞学教师；387年受安布罗斯施洗

label.en: Returns to Thagaste, founds a community
label.zh: 返回塔加斯特，建立修道团体

label.en: Ordained at Hippo Regius; bishop from c. 395
label.zh: 在希波任神父；约395年起任主教

label.en: Dies during the Vandal siege of Hippo
label.zh: 在汪达尔人围攻希波时去世

sources.title: Wikipedia: Augustine of Hippo
Peter Brown, Augustine of Hippo: A Biography (rev. ed., 2000)
Augustine, Confessions (c. 397–400)
Possidius, Life of Augustine (c. 432)

role.zh: 数学家、天文学家、新柏拉图主义哲学家

summary.en: Daughter of the mathematician Theon, Hypatia taught philosophy and mathematics in Alexandria and advised the city’s elite, pagan and Christian alike. Caught up in a feud between the prefect Orestes and Bishop Cyril, she was murdered by a Christian mob in 415.
summary.zh: 希帕提娅是数学家席昂之女，在亚历山大城讲授哲学与数学，为城中异教与基督教精英所敬重并充当顾问。她卷入总督奥瑞斯提斯与主教西里尔之争，415年遭基督徒暴民杀害。

label.zh: 生于亚历山大城（约350–370年）

label.en: Serapeum destroyed; she continues to teach
label.zh: 塞拉皮斯神庙被毁，她仍继续讲学

label.en: Leading teacher of Neoplatonism; pupils include Synesius
label.zh: 新柏拉图主义名师，学生包括辛奈西斯

label.en: Murdered by a mob during Lent
label.zh: 于大斋期间遭暴民杀害

sources.title: Wikipedia: Hypatia
Maria Dzielska, Hypatia of Alexandria (1995)
Socrates Scholasticus, Ecclesiastical History, VII.15
Britannica: Hypatia

summary.en: Ezana ruled Aksum at its height and became the first sub-Saharan monarch known to adopt Christianity. Trilingual inscriptions in Geʿez, Sabaean and Greek record his campaigns, including one against the Noba near Meroë. His birth and death years are unrecorded; the years shown are placeholders.
summary.zh: 埃扎纳在阿克苏姆鼎盛时期执政，是已知最早皈依基督教的撒哈拉以南君主。其吉兹语、萨巴语和希腊语三语铭文记载了他的征战，包括在麦罗埃附近对诺巴人的远征。其生卒年不见记载，此处所示年份仅为占位估计。

label.en: Succeeds as a minor; regency of his mother
label.zh: 幼年继位，由母亲摄政
皈依基督教，弗鲁门修斯任主教

label.en: Campaign against the Noba near Meroë
label.zh: 在麦罗埃附近征讨诺巴人

label.en: Addressed by Emperor Constantius II in a letter
label.zh: 罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世致信于他

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ezana of Axum
S. Munro-Hay, Aksum: An African Civilisation of Late Antiquity (1991)
Rufinus of Aquileia, Ecclesiastical History, X.9–10
Athanasius, Apology to Constantius, 31 (letter to Ezana and Sazana)

note: Placeholder life dates: no source records Ezana’s birth or death. born=315 merely assumes he was a child at his accession c. 330 (Rufinus); died=360 is shortly after the last firm reference to him (Constantius II’s letter, c. 356). Only the reign (c. 330–c. 360) is attested, and that only approximately.

summary.en: A Lamtuna Sanhaja chief from the western Sahara, Yusuf built the Almoravid movement into an empire, founding Marrakesh and taking Fez. Invited by the taifa kings of al-Andalus, he defeated Alfonso VI at Sagrajas and then annexed Muslim Spain.
summary.zh: 优素福出身西撒哈拉的拉姆图纳·桑哈贾部落首领，将穆拉比特运动发展为帝国，建立马拉喀什并攻取非斯。他应安达卢斯诸泰法国王之请，在萨格拉哈斯击败阿方索六世，随后吞并穆斯林西班牙。

label.en: Made deputy in Morocco at Aghmat by Abu Bakr ibn ʿUmar
label.zh: 在阿格马特受阿布·伯克尔·伊本·欧麦尔委任主政摩洛哥
营建马拉喀什为都城
攻取非斯
在萨格拉哈斯（扎拉卡）击败阿方索六世

label.en: Deposes the taifa king of Granada
label.zh: 废黜格拉纳达泰法国王
卒于马拉喀什

sources.title: Wikipedia: Yusuf ibn Tashfin
Amira K. Bennison, The Almoravid and Almohad Empires (2016)
Ibn Abi Zarʿ, Rawd al-Qirtas (c. 1326)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. III: Africa from the Seventh to the Eleventh Century (ed. M. El Fasi & I. Hrbek, 1988)

note: Birth year (c. 1009) is traditional; Fez is dated 1069–1075 in different chronicles.

summary.en: Remembered in the griots’ epic as a disabled child who rose to free the Mande from Sosso domination, Sundiata defeated Sumanguru at Kirina and founded the Mali Empire. Ibn Khaldun, writing a century later, records him as Mari Jata.
summary.zh: 在格里奥史诗中，松迪亚塔幼年残疾，后崛起将曼丁人从索索统治下解放。他在基里纳击败苏曼古鲁，建立马里帝国。一个世纪后，伊本·赫勒敦以“马里·贾塔”之名记载了他。

label.zh: 生于曼丁（传统认为在尼亚尼）

label.en: Exile at the court of Mema (approx.)
label.zh: 流亡梅马王廷（位置约略）
在基里纳击败苏曼古鲁

label.en: Rules Mali from the Niger valley; absorbs former Ghana lands
label.zh: 在尼日尔河谷统治马里，兼并原加纳故地

label.en: Dies (by tradition drowned in the Sankarani)
label.zh: 去世（传说溺于桑卡拉尼河）

sources.title: Wikipedia: Sundiata Keita
D. T. Niane, Sundiata: An Epic of Old Mali (trans. G. D. Pickett, 1965)
Ibn Khaldun, Kitab al-ʿIbar, in Levtzion & Hopkins, Corpus
Nehemia Levtzion, Ancient Ghana and Mali (1973)

note: Life dates and places derive from oral tradition; the location of the Mali capital is debated.

summary.en: Ruler of Mali at its greatest extent, Musa made a celebrated pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324–1325, displaying such wealth in Cairo that Arab writers recalled it for decades. He annexed Gao and Timbuktu and patronised mosques and scholars, establishing Timbuktu as a centre of learning.
summary.zh: 穆萨统治时马里疆域最为辽阔，1324–1325年赴麦加朝觐，在开罗显示的财富令阿拉伯作家数十年津津乐道。他兼并加奥和廷巴克图，资助清真寺与学者，使廷巴克图成为学术中心。

label.zh: 即位为曼萨
朝觐途中抵达开罗
完成朝觐
加奥归附马里
下令修建津加雷贝尔清真寺
去世

sources.title: Wikipedia: Mansa Musa
al-ʿUmari, Masalik al-Absar, in Levtzion & Hopkins, Corpus
al-Sa'di, Tarikh al-Sudan (c. 1655), trans. J. O. Hunwick, Timbuktu and the Songhay Empire (2003)
Nehemia Levtzion, Ancient Ghana and Mali (1973)

note: Reign dates vary (1312–1337 per Ibn Khaldun’s chronology; some give 1307–1332).

summary.en: A Berber jurist from Tangier, Ibn Battuta travelled for nearly thirty years through the Islamic world and beyond, from the Swahili coast to China. His Rihla, dictated in Fez, includes the only eyewitness description of the court of Mali under Mansa Sulayman (1352–1353).
summary.zh: 丹吉尔的柏柏尔法学家伊本·白图泰游历伊斯兰世界及更远地区近三十年，足迹从斯瓦希里海岸直至中国。他在非斯口述的《游记》包含唯一一份亲历马里曼萨苏莱曼宫廷（1352–1353年）的记载。

label.zh: 离开丹吉尔前往麦加
亚历山大与开罗
在麦加朝觐并居留
摩加迪沙
基尔瓦，盛赞其城建精美

label.en: Judge in Delhi under Muhammad bin Tughluq
label.zh: 在德里任穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的法官
中国泉州（刺桐）
返回非斯
穿越撒哈拉抵达瓦拉塔

label.en: Court of Mansa Sulayman of Mali (capital site debated)
label.zh: 马里曼萨苏莱曼宫廷（都城位置有争议）
廷巴克图与加奥

label.en: Dictates the Rihla to Ibn Juzayy
label.zh: 向伊本·朱扎伊口述《游记》

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ibn Battuta
Ibn Battuta, Rihla, trans. H. A. R. Gibb & C. F. Beckingham, The Travels of Ibn Battuta (1958–1994)
Ross E. Dunn, The Adventures of Ibn Battuta (1986)
N. Levtzion & J. F. P. Hopkins (eds.), Corpus of Early Arabic Sources for West African History (1981)

note: Wikidata gives death 1368; other sources say 1368/69 or 1377. Some itinerary dates are disputed by scholars.

role.zh: 历史学家、法学家、政治家

summary.en: Born in Hafsid Tunis to an Andalusi family, Ibn Khaldun served several North African and Granadan courts before writing the Muqaddimah and his universal history. He spent his last decades in Mamluk Cairo as a Maliki judge and met Timur outside Damascus in 1401.
summary.zh: 伊本·赫勒敦生于哈夫斯王朝治下突尼斯的安达卢斯家族，先后效力于北非诸王廷和格拉纳达，之后写成《历史绪论》及通史。晚年数十年在马穆鲁克开罗任马利克派法官，1401年在大马士革城外会见帖木儿。

label.zh: 生于突尼斯

label.en: Joins the Marinid court at Fez
label.zh: 入非斯马林王朝宫廷

label.en: At the Nasrid court of Granada; envoy to Seville
label.zh: 在格拉纳达奈斯尔宫廷，出使塞维利亚
任贝贾亚宫廷侍从长

label.en: Retreat at Qalʿat Ibn Salama; writes the Muqaddimah
label.zh: 隐居伊本·萨拉马堡，撰写《历史绪论》
返回突尼斯讲学

label.en: Settles in Cairo; Maliki chief judge
label.zh: 定居开罗，任马利克派首席法官
在大马士革城外会见帖木儿
卒于开罗

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ibn Khaldun
Robert Irwin, Ibn Khaldun: An Intellectual Biography (2018)
Ibn Khaldun, al-Taʿrif (autobiography)
Britannica: Ibn Khaldūn

name.zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世

summary.en: A Soninke general under Sonni Ali, Muhammad Ture seized the Songhai throne at Anfao in 1493 and founded the Askia dynasty. He reorganised the empire’s provinces and army, made the hajj, was named caliph for the western Sudan, and extended Songhai rule from the Atlantic hinterland to Hausaland.
summary.zh: 穆罕默德·图雷原为索尼·阿里麾下的索宁克将领，1493年在安法奥夺取桑海王位，开创阿斯基亚王朝。他整顿行省与军队，赴麦加朝觐并被封为西苏丹哈里发，使桑海统治从大西洋内陆延伸至豪萨地区。

label.en: Seizes power at Anfao near Gao
label.zh: 在加奥附近的安法奥夺权

label.en: In Cairo on pilgrimage; invested by the Abbasid caliph
label.zh: 朝觐途经开罗，受阿拔斯哈里发册封
完成朝觐

label.en: Returns; campaigns against Mossi and others
label.zh: 回国后征讨莫西等
被其子穆萨废黜

label.en: Dies; buried in the Tomb of Askia
label.zh: 去世，葬于阿斯基亚陵

sources.title: Wikipedia: Askia Muhammad I
al-Sa'di, Tarikh al-Sudan (c. 1655), trans. J. O. Hunwick, Timbuktu and the Songhay Empire (2003)
Tarikh al-Fattash (16th–17th century)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Tomb of Askia

note: Birth year (1443) is approximate; chronicle dates for his hajj vary by a year.

summary.en: Born in Granada and raised in Fez, al-Hasan al-Wazzan travelled as a Moroccan envoy to Timbuktu and Egypt. Captured by Christian corsairs, he was baptised by Pope Leo X and wrote the Description of Africa, Europe’s main source on the African interior for two centuries.
summary.zh: 哈桑·瓦赞生于格拉纳达，在非斯长大，作为摩洛哥使节到过廷巴克图和埃及。他被基督教海盗俘获，由教宗利奥十世施洗，所著《非洲志》在两个世纪里是欧洲了解非洲内陆的主要资料。

label.zh: 生于格拉纳达
举家定居非斯

label.en: Visits Timbuktu and the Songhai lands
label.zh: 游历廷巴克图及桑海诸地

label.en: In Egypt at the time of the Ottoman conquest
label.zh: 奥斯曼征服时身在埃及

label.en: Captured by corsairs and presented to Leo X
label.zh: 被海盗俘获并献给利奥十世
受洗，名约翰内斯·利奥·德·美第奇
完成《非洲志》
返回北非（可能在突尼斯）

sources.title: Wikipedia: Leo Africanus
Natalie Zemon Davis, Trickster Travels: A Sixteenth-Century Muslim between Worlds (2006)
Leo Africanus, Cosmographia de Affrica (1526; printed by Ramusio 1550)

note: Death year unknown (after c. 1550); Wikidata gives only the 16th century. 1554 is a conventional estimate.

summary.en: The most celebrated scholar of Timbuktu, Ahmad Baba wrote some forty works on law, grammar and biography. After the Moroccan conquest he was deported in chains to Marrakesh, where he taught; his treatise on slavery argued against enslaving Muslims.
summary.zh: 艾哈迈德·巴巴是廷巴克图最负盛名的学者，著有约四十部法学、语法和传记著作。摩洛哥征服后，他被锁押至马拉喀什，在那里讲学；其论奴隶制的著作反对奴役穆斯林。

label.zh: 生于廷巴克图附近的阿拉万
在廷巴克图讲学

label.en: Deported to Marrakesh after the Moroccan conquest
label.zh: 摩洛哥征服后被押往马拉喀什
获准返回廷巴克图
卒于廷巴克图

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ahmad Baba al-Timbukti
al-Sa'di, Tarikh al-Sudan (c. 1655), trans. J. O. Hunwick, Timbuktu and the Songhay Empire (2003)
J. O. Hunwick, “Ahmad Baba and the Moroccan Invasion of the Sudan (1591)”, Journal of the Historical Society of Nigeria 2/3 (1962)

note: Birthplace given as Araouane by several sources; others say Timbuktu.

name.zh: 恩东戈与马坦巴女王恩津加

summary.en: Njinga Mbande negotiated with the Portuguese in Luanda in 1622, then ruled Ndongo and conquered Matamba. For three decades she fought Portuguese expansion through war, alliances with the Dutch and Imbangala, and diplomacy, securing a peace treaty in 1657.
summary.zh: 恩津加·姆班德于1622年在罗安达与葡萄牙人谈判，随后统治恩东戈并征服马坦巴。三十年间她以战争、与荷兰人和因班加拉人结盟以及外交手段抵抗葡萄牙扩张，于1657年取得和约。

label.en: Born at the Ndongo court (Kabasa, approx.)
label.zh: 生于恩东戈王廷（卡巴萨，约略）

label.en: Embassy to the Portuguese governor in Luanda; baptised Ana
label.zh: 出使罗安达葡萄牙总督，受洗名安娜
在恩东戈掌权
征服马坦巴作为新根据地（约略）
荷兰盟友被逐出罗安达
与葡萄牙缔结和约
卒于马坦巴

sources.title: Wikipedia: Nzinga of Ndongo and Matamba
Linda M. Heywood, Njinga of Angola: Africa’s Warrior Queen (2017)
Giovanni Antonio Cavazzi, Istorica descrizione de’ tre regni Congo, Matamba et Angola (1687)

name.zh: 多娜·贝亚特丽斯·金帕·维塔

role.en: Prophet of the Antonian movement in Kongo
role.zh: 刚果安东尼派运动女先知

summary.en: A young Kongolese noblewoman, Kimpa Vita declared herself possessed by Saint Anthony and preached an Africanised Catholicism, urging the reunification of the war-torn kingdom. Her followers reoccupied the ruined capital São Salvador before King Pedro IV had her burned as a heretic.
summary.zh: 刚果年轻贵族女子金帕·维塔宣称圣安东尼附身，宣讲本土化的天主教，呼吁饱受战乱的王国重新统一。她的追随者重新占据已成废墟的首都圣萨尔瓦多，后国王佩德罗四世以异端罪将她处以火刑。

label.zh: 生于基班古山附近（约略）
宣称为圣安东尼附身
追随者重占圣萨尔瓦多（姆班扎刚果）

label.en: Burned at Evululu on Pedro IV’s orders
label.zh: 奉佩德罗四世之命在埃武卢卢被处火刑

sources.title: Wikipedia: Kimpa Vita
John K. Thornton, The Kongolese Saint Anthony: Dona Beatriz Kimpa Vita and the Antonian Movement (1998)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. V: Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century (ed. B. A. Ogot, 1992)

note: Kibangu and Evululu positions are approximate.

role.en: Scholar, reformer and founder of the Sokoto Caliphate
role.zh: 学者、改革者、索科托哈里发国创建者

summary.en: A Fulani scholar of the Qadiriyya order, Usman dan Fodio preached reform in Hausaland for thirty years before leading the jihad of 1804. He wrote over a hundred works in Arabic, Fulfulde and Hausa and left the administration of the new caliphate to his son Muhammad Bello and brother Abdullahi.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥是卡迪里教团的富拉尼学者，在豪萨地区宣讲改革三十年后，于1804年领导圣战。他以阿拉伯语、富拉语和豪萨语写下百余部著作，将新哈里发国的治理交给儿子穆罕默德·贝洛和兄弟阿卜杜拉希。

label.zh: 生于戈比尔的马拉塔（约略）
在德格尔开始传教（约略）

label.en: Hijra to Gudu; proclaimed Commander of the Faithful
label.zh: 迁徙至古杜，被拥立为“信士的长官”

label.en: Fall of Alkalawa, capital of Gobir (approx.)
label.zh: 戈比尔都城阿尔卡拉瓦陷落（约略）
定居索科托
卒于索科托

sources.title: Wikipedia: Usman dan Fodio
Murray Last, The Sokoto Caliphate (1967)
Mervyn Hiskett, The Sword of Truth (1973)

summary.en: Trained in the army of the Mthethwa paramount Dingiswayo, Shaka took over the small Zulu chiefdom in 1816 and, through age-regiments and new close-combat tactics, forged a powerful centralised kingdom. He was assassinated by his half-brothers Dingane and Mhlangana in 1828.
summary.zh: 恰卡曾在姆特特瓦首领丁吉斯瓦约麾下受训，1816年接掌弱小的祖鲁酋邦，凭借年龄兵团与新的近战战术建立起强大的中央集权王国。1828年被同父异母兄弟丁冈与姆兰加纳刺杀。

label.zh: 生于森赞加科纳与南迪之家（约略）
在丁吉斯瓦约的姆特特瓦军中服役（约略）
成为祖鲁首领，建夸布拉瓦约（约略）

label.en: Defeats the Ndwandwe at the Mhlatuze (approx.)
label.zh: 在姆拉图泽河击败恩德万德人（约略）
迁居夸杜库扎
在夸杜库扎遇刺

sources.title: Wikipedia: Shaka
Carolyn Hamilton, Terrific Majesty: The Powers of Shaka Zulu and the Limits of Historical Invention (1998)
Jeff Guy, The Destruction of the Zulu Kingdom (1979)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VI: Africa in the Nineteenth Century until the 1880s (ed. J. F. Ade Ajayi, 1989)

note: Birth year approximate; early-life sites known only approximately.

summary.en: An Albanian officer sent against the French, Muhammad Ali seized power in Egypt, destroyed the Mamluk elite and built a conscript army, state monopolies and factories. His campaigns reached Arabia, Sudan and Syria, and his dynasty ruled Egypt until 1952.
summary.zh: 穆罕默德·阿里原为奉派抗击法军的阿尔巴尼亚军官，夺取埃及政权后消灭马穆鲁克精英，建立征兵制军队、国家专营和工厂。其征战远及阿拉伯半岛、苏丹和叙利亚，他的王朝统治埃及直至1952年。

label.zh: 生于卡瓦拉（奥斯曼马其顿）

label.en: Lands with Ottoman forces against the French
label.zh: 随奥斯曼军登陆抗击法军
获承认为埃及总督

label.en: Massacre of the Mamluks at the Citadel
label.zh: 在城堡屠杀马穆鲁克

label.en: Conquest of Sudan; Khartoum founded soon after

summary.en: King of Shewa from 1865 and emperor from 1889, Menelik expanded Ethiopia south and west to roughly its modern borders, founded Addis Ababa with Empress Taytu, and defeated Italy at Adwa. He introduced railways, telegraphs and modern schools.
summary.zh: 孟尼利克1865年起为绍阿国王，1889年称帝，将埃塞俄比亚向南、向西扩张至大致今日的疆界，与泰图皇后共建亚的斯亚贝巴，并在阿杜瓦击败意大利。他引入了铁路、电报和现代学校。

summary.en: Of noble Semien and Yejju descent, Taytu married Menelik in 1883 and became one of the most powerful figures at court. She chose the site of Addis Ababa, opposed the Treaty of Wuchale, commanded troops at Adwa, and effectively governed during Menelik’s final illness.
summary.zh: 泰图出身塞米恩与耶居贵族，1883年嫁给孟尼利克，成为宫廷中最有权势的人物之一。她选定亚的斯亚贝巴的城址，反对《乌查利条约》，在阿杜瓦指挥军队，并在孟尼利克病重期间实际执政。

summary.en: A Maninka trader turned military leader, Samori built the Wassoulou state with a disciplined army armed with imported breech-loading and repeating rifles, plus copies made by his own smiths. He resisted French conquest for nearly two decades, relocating his whole state eastward, until his capture in 1898.
summary.zh: 萨摩里原为马林凯商人，后成为军事领袖，建立瓦苏卢国家，其纪律严明的军队装备进口的后膛枪和连发步枪，并有自家铁匠仿制的枪支。他抵抗法国征服近二十年，甚至将整个国家东迁，直至1898年被俘。

label.zh: 生于马尼扬巴拉杜古（约略）

summary.en: Ras Tafari Makonnen became regent in 1916 and emperor in 1930. His 1936 appeal to the League of Nations against Italian aggression made him a world figure; restored in 1941, he modernised the state autocratically, hosted the OAU’s founding, and was deposed by the Derg in 1974.
summary.zh: 拉斯·塔法里·马康南1916年成为摄政，1930年称帝。1936年他就意大利侵略向国际联盟发出呼吁，成为世界性人物；1941年复位后以专制方式推动国家现代化，主持非统组织成立，1974年被“德尔格”推翻。

summary.en: Educated in the Gold Coast, the United States and Britain, Nkrumah co-organised the 1945 Pan-African Congress, founded the Convention People’s Party and led Ghana to independence in 1957. A leading advocate of African unity, he grew increasingly authoritarian and was overthrown in 1966.
summary.zh: 恩克鲁玛先后在黄金海岸、美国和英国求学，参与组织1945年泛非大会，创建人民大会党，并于1957年领导加纳独立。他是非洲统一的主要倡导者，但统治日趋专制，1966年被推翻。

role.en: First prime minister of the Congo

summary.en: A postal clerk and writer from Kasai, Lumumba founded the Mouvement National Congolais and became the Congo’s first prime minister in June 1960. Deposed amid secession and Cold War pressure, he was handed to Katangese authorities and executed with Belgian complicity in January 1961.
summary.zh: 卢蒙巴来自开赛，曾为邮政职员和作家，创建刚果民族运动，1960年6月成为刚果首任总理。在分裂与冷战压力下被罢免，他被移交加丹加当局，于1961年1月在比利时同谋下遭处决。

summary.en: A lawyer and ANC leader, Mandela co-founded the armed wing Umkhonto we Sizwe and was sentenced to life imprisonment at the Rivonia trial. Released after 27 years, he negotiated the end of apartheid, shared the 1993 Nobel Peace Prize and served as South Africa’s first democratically elected president (1994–1999).
summary.zh: 曼德拉是律师和非国大领导人，参与创建武装组织“民族之矛”，在利沃尼亚审判中被判终身监禁。入狱27年后获释，他通过谈判终结种族隔离，获1993年诺贝尔和平奖，并出任南非首位民选总统（1994–1999年）。

summary.en: The first woman in East and Central Africa to earn a doctorate, Maathai founded the Green Belt Movement, which mobilised women to plant tens of millions of trees. She fought land grabs and authoritarian rule, served as a Kenyan MP and minister, and in 2004 became the first African woman to win the Nobel Peace Prize.

summary.en: An army officer who led the Free Officers’ coup of 1952, Nasser became president in 1956 and nationalised the Suez Canal, surviving the Anglo-French-Israeli invasion. A champion of pan-Arabism and non-alignment, he built the Aswan High Dam and supported African liberation movements.
